name: Deploy Website
description: Deploy a static website from Google Drive to Firebase Hosting. Recursively downloads ALL site content (HTML, CSS, images, subdirectories) from a Drive folder, deploys to a staging preview channel for approval, then promotes to production after owner sign-off.

drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID containing the website files (e.g. 1s5yUdEH5M5ugISHG9oqauQzDXuMszKjV for tachin-website)

firebase_project.description: Firebase project ID for hosting deployment (e.g. tachin-website). NOT architect-prime-beta.

hosting_dir.description: Path to the Firebase Hosting config directory containing firebase.json

steps.title: Recursively download ALL website content from Google Drive
steps.description:
Download the complete website file tree from Google Drive, including all subdirectories (images/, images/profile-pics/, etc.).

Run this SINGLE command to clean, download, and verify in one step:
```bash
rm -rf ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public && mkdir -p ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public && /opt/corekit/bin/drive-download-folder ${drive_folder_id} --output ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public && echo '=== File listing ===' && find ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public -type f | sort && echo '=== Count ===' && find ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public -type f | wc -l && echo '=== Images check ===' && ls -R ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public/images/
```

⚠️ CRITICAL: Run as ONE command chain. Do NOT split into separate commands.
⚠️ The download MUST include subdirectories like images/ and images/profile-pics/. A deployment without images is a FAILED deployment.

Output: complete file listing with counts for each directory.
steps.accept_criteria: Files downloaded to hosting_public. The output shows: (a) HTML files at root, (b) images/ directory with image files, (c) images/profile-pics/ with profile photos. Total file count is reported. If images/ is empty or missing, this step FAILS.

steps.title: Verify firebase.json and hosting configuration
steps.accept_criteria: firebase.json exists with hosting.public set to 'hosting_public' and the /public/** rewrite rule preserved.

steps.title: Deploy to staging preview channel
steps.description:
Deploy the website to a Firebase Hosting preview channel for review.

Run this command:
```bash
cd ${hosting_dir} && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --project=${firebase_project} --expires 7d
```

Extract the staging preview URL from the command output (look for 'Channel URL').

Output: the staging preview URL.
steps.accept_criteria: The firebase hosting:channel:deploy command ran successfully (output shows 'Deploy complete'). The staging preview URL is extracted and reported.

steps.title: Verify staging deployment completeness
steps.description:
Before requesting approval, verify the staging deployment has ALL assets.

Check these URLs against the staging preview URL:
```bash
STAGING_URL="<staging-url-from-previous-step>"
for path in '' 'styles.css' 'home.html' 'about.html' 'security.html' 'privacy.html' 'terms.html' 'newly-released.html'; do
  CODE=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${STAGING_URL}/${path}")
  echo "  /${path}: HTTP ${CODE}"
done
# Check images
for img in $(find ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public/images -type f -name '*.png' -o -name '*.jpg' 2>/dev/null | head -5 | sed "s|${hosting_dir}/hosting_public/||"); do
  CODE=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${STAGING_URL}/${img}")
  echo "  /${img}: HTTP ${CODE}"
done
```

⚠️ If ANY page or image returns 404, the deployment is INCOMPLETE. Go back to Step 1.

Output: HTTP status for each page and a sample of images.
steps.accept_criteria: All HTML pages return HTTP 200. At least 3 image URLs return HTTP 200. No 404s detected.

steps.title: Request owner approval
steps.description:
Report the staging URL to the owner and request approval before promoting to production.

Send a message with:
- The staging preview URL
- A summary of what was deployed (file count, folder structure, image count)
- A request for the owner to review and approve for production deployment

⚠️ STOP HERE and wait for owner approval. Do NOT proceed to production deployment without explicit approval.
steps.accept_criteria: The staging URL and deployment summary have been reported. The message clearly requests owner approval before proceeding.

steps.title: Deploy to production
steps.description:
After receiving owner approval, deploy to the live production site.

Run this command:
```bash
cd ${hosting_dir} && firebase deploy --only hosting --project=${firebase_project}
```

Extract the production Hosting URL from the command output (look for 'Hosting URL').

Output: the production URL.
steps.accept_criteria: The firebase deploy command ran successfully (output shows 'Deploy complete'). The production URL is extracted and reported.

steps.title: Verify production deployment completeness
steps.description:
Verify the production site has ALL pages AND images loading correctly.

Run:
```bash
for path in '' 'styles.css' 'home.html' 'about.html' 'security.html'; do
  CODE=$(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://${firebase_project}.web.app/${path}")
  SIZE=$(curl -sf "https://${firebase_project}.web.app/${path}" | wc -c)
  echo "  /${path}: HTTP ${CODE} (${SIZE} bytes)"
done
```

Also verify at least one image loads:
```bash
curl -sf -o /dev/null -w 'Logo: HTTP %{http_code}' https://${firebase_project}.web.app/tachin_logo.png
```

Output: HTTP status codes and sizes for all pages plus sample images.
steps.accept_criteria: All pages return HTTP 200 with non-zero content size. At least one image returns HTTP 200. The production site is fully functional.
